Elena — great to hear. Quick answers and proposal below.

Surge protection options (pilot):
- Hard cap: we can set a token/hour hard cap for the pilot window and route excess to a throttled queue (no surprise invoice).
- Soft cap + buffer: allow spikes up to 25% over pilot allocation, with automatic alerting; overages billed at a capped rate (we can set a surge cap rate).

Conversion / credit mechanics:
- Standard: unused pilot credits expire at pilot close.
- Conditional rebate (recommended): if Civicaitech signs a Dedicated or annual Consumption contract within 60 days, we apply a one-time rebate equal to up to 50% of unused pilot credits (applied to the first invoice). Rebate requires execution of the conversion order and standard SOW.

For this case I'd propose: 30-day pilot, soft cap + 25% buffer, and a conditional rebate of 40% of unused pilot credits if you convert within 60 days. If you commit to a 6-month Dedicated plan at signing, we can increase the rebate to 60%.

I've attached a short quote and a redline-friendly clause you can share with procurement. If that direction works, I'll loop in finance for approval of the 60% higher-rebate path.

Next steps: review quote (attached), confirm preferred surge option, and we can draft a short amendment to the SOW for procurement.

—Kimberly
